sources.title: Lustre parallel filesystems
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: DAOS checksum：絕對位移對齊與觸碰區塊
related.titleEn: DAOS checksums: absolute alignment and touched chunks
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付區間表、writer 所有權圖、正反順序結果與 union/intersection 核算；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver intervals, per-position writer ownership, both execution orders and the union/intersection reconciliation. Preserve the distinction between a correctness proof and an unmeasured filesystem performance claim. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 建立 update_offset、length、chunk_size，輸出每個交集 chunk_id 與觸碰範圍；不把區塊數直接當實際讀取次數。
related.differenceEn: Record update offset, length and chunk size, then emit each intersected chunk identifier and byte range. Chunk count is an alignment metric, not a claim about actual read operations or implementation-specific repair traffic.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 兩半開區間交集長度為 max(0,min(endA,endB)-max(startA,startB))；相接端點不算共享位元組；A 寫 [0,3) MiB；B 名義寫 [3,6)，變更寫 [2,5)；各程序長度均為 3 MiB；名義式 max(0,min(3,6)-max(0,3)) = 0 MiB overlap；變更式 max(0,min(3,5)-max(0,2)) = 1 MiB overlap。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

非空區間 [o,o+L) 觸碰區塊數為 ceil((o+L)/C)-floor(o/C)；零長度要獨立回傳零；checksum chunk 為 1024 B、更新長度 1024 B；名義起點 512 B，變更對齊為 0；名義式 ceil((512+1024)/1024)-floor(512/1024) = 2 checksum chunks touched；變更式 ceil((0+1024)/1024)-floor(0/1024) = 1 checksum chunks touched。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Overlap length of two half-open intervals is the positive difference between the smaller end and larger start. Adjacent endpoints do not share bytes under this explicitly chosen interval convention. Writer A owns [0,3) MiB. Writer B changes from [3,6) to [2,5), retaining a 3 MiB length in both cases. Offset ranges are synthetic and do not describe Lustre’s actual lock extents. Nominal max(0,min(3,6)-max(0,3)) = 0 MiB overlap; changed max(0,min(3,5)-max(0,2)) = 1 MiB overlap. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

For a nonempty interval [o,o+L), touched chunks equal ceiling((o+L)/C) minus floor(o/C). Handle zero length separately, since the nonempty formula can miscount an unaligned empty interval. Use 1024-byte checksum chunks and a 1024-byte update. Starting offset changes from 512 bytes to zero, while payload length and logical contents remain fixed. Nominal ceil((512+1024)/1024)-floor(512/1024) = 2 checksum chunks touched; changed ceil((0+1024)/1024)-floor(0/1024) = 1 checksum chunks touched. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: DLC 混合冷卻：殘餘空氣熱負載
related.titleEn: Hybrid DLC cooling: residual heat assigned to air cooling
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付區間表、writer 所有權圖、正反順序結果與 union/intersection 核算；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver intervals, per-position writer ownership, both execution orders and the union/intersection reconciliation. Preserve the distinction between a correctness proof and an unmeasured filesystem performance claim. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 列出元件、發熱、液冷份額與空氣份額；將 PSU 損失是否已含於 IT 邊界註明，避免重複加算。
related.differenceEn: List components, heat, liquid fraction and air fraction. State whether power-supply losses are already inside the IT boundary so they cannot be added twice to the room-air requirement.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 兩半開區間交集長度為 max(0,min(endA,endB)-max(startA,startB))；相接端點不算共享位元組；A 寫 [0,3) MiB；B 名義寫 [3,6)，變更寫 [2,5)；各程序長度均為 3 MiB；名義式 max(0,min(3,6)-max(0,3)) = 0 MiB overlap；變更式 max(0,min(3,5)-max(0,2)) = 1 MiB overlap。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

固定 IT 發熱 P、液冷捕獲率 f 時，殘餘空氣熱量為 P(1-f)；f 必須按同一熱邊界定義；教學機架 IT 發熱 160 kW；液冷捕獲率由 80% 下降到 70%，不含房間其他設備；名義式 160*(1-0.8) = 32 kW air heat；變更式 160*(1-0.7) = 48 kW air heat。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Overlap length of two half-open intervals is the positive difference between the smaller end and larger start. Adjacent endpoints do not share bytes under this explicitly chosen interval convention. Writer A owns [0,3) MiB. Writer B changes from [3,6) to [2,5), retaining a 3 MiB length in both cases. Offset ranges are synthetic and do not describe Lustre’s actual lock extents. Nominal max(0,min(3,6)-max(0,3)) = 0 MiB overlap; changed max(0,min(3,5)-max(0,2)) = 1 MiB overlap. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

For fixed IT heat P and liquid capture fraction f, residual air heat is P(1-f). Define both terms over the same boundary; a capture fraction for processors alone cannot represent all rack heat. A synthetic rack produces 160 kW of IT heat. Liquid capture falls from 80% to 70%, excluding other room equipment and facility losses from the stated boundary. Nominal 160*(1-0.8) = 32 kW air heat; changed 160*(1-0.7) = 48 kW air heat. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
